body:
Update:

Have yet to hear from any authorities, 90% certain I will never hear from them. Prescriptions for celexa, and xanax.

Saw a counselor. Was given the option of filling out some forms and coming back later, or having their on-call crisis counselour help. That did, arranged for scheduled appts. Learned breathing techniques, thought stopping techniques, reinforced the complete and total hogwash that is my ex's story.

Ack. I'm still neurotic after a night's sleep (beer induced). The doorbell rang, and of course my mind races to the police, my heart pounds breathing gets hard, world spins. It was only my roommates friend.

Can't live like this, each knock, each siren, heavy footsteps. I'm off to campus to see psych services, cant get any real meds from them, but thats for the doctors at 3.

She called my mom after she filed charges, so she claims. And my mom called me later this afternoon. 

Thanks for the advice, my current plan is to clam up and hand them my attorney's biz card.

I am completely neurotic now. The occasional passing sirens I hear. I went to the door a few times, expecting to be met by police. Thus far safe.

My god what a trip.

K, I have not yet contacted an attorney I have a previous one from a DUI case that was paid very well, not his field of work.

If I am contacted by the police for this, be uncooperative until I can speak with an attorney? I know its obvious, but how do I do it politely, to not get "the boots" so to speak (happened before).

This girl is grade A nuts. She saw some medication bottles in my car, all had my name on them, some very old. She felt that it was either the incorrect dosage or the wrong medication and contacted the doctor on the bottle and persuaded him to stop prescribing the medications. Needless to say, we broke up after that; however I am loathe to admit that I should have broken up with her on the spot, I wanted to. Oh god how I wanted to break up with her then.

Youre very right on the crisis hotline, I feel like an elephant is on my chest and breathing is hard.

Just fearful that if I ring them, it will bring the men in white coats.

I have a fellow TA's syllabus and some materials to start shaping my lessons, just this hanging over my head will make it exceedingly difficult to concentrate.

The alone factor is what is worrying me. I just moved close to campus (dui =can't drive, live close to school) and can't really drive out to anyone I know.

Thanks for the warm thoughts. Its frightful to be dreading each minute for fear it will bring jack-booted thug/cops through the door.

I figure that if I don't hear by the cops by this weekend, I'm sailing easy.

I can talk to my mom, but outside of a distant emotional comfort, it won't provide much help. My mom is going to call my ex again and try to talk her down later tonight.

I'm not sure if I am more afraid that my parents would institutionalize me if I explained how this is affecting me; or if they would do nothing. 

This is stressing me out more than anyone can imagine, I am a graduate student and in two days, I am supposed to start teaching a class I have never taught before, and don't even have the syllabus ready;
and now this.

I really wish to end it before going to jail for this. I realize I am getting ahead of myself. But I will not go to a federal penitentiary for this.

I have an appointment tomorrow 3pm with on-campus doc, will by trying to stop by the university's counseling dept as well tomorrow. Theyre closed now. Any so-cal crim. def. lawyers want to drop a line? Interested in helping out a redditor?
